summary: Window title setting is implemented. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title), gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests were appended to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so mypy, Black, and the test suite are unverified.
